name: Careplus Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Careplus 以 RM42.00 million 出售位于 Seremban 的土地及零售综合楼，并以 RM3.8 million 出售 Centro Heights Sdn. Bhd. 全部股权；同时以 RM30.00 收购 NexV Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. 30% 股权并终止相关合资协议。公司亦推进供股等集资活动。
overview_en: In 2026, Careplus disposed of a parcel of land with a retail complex in Seremban for RM42.00 million and the entire equity interest in Centro Heights Sdn. Bhd. for RM3.8 million; it also acquired a 30% equity interest in NexV Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. for RM30.00 and terminated the related joint venture agreement. The company also pursued fund-raising activities including a rights issue.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面进行了资产出售、股权收购及供股等集资活动。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company carried out asset disposals, an equity acquisition and fund-raising activities including a rights issue.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF UP TO 425,394,849 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN CAREPLUS GROUP BE
actions.text_en: Proposed renounceable rights issue of up to 425,394,849 new ordinary shares on the basis of 1 rights share for every 2 existing shares held.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述土地及零售综合楼出售事项签订补充协议。
actions.text_en: Entered into a supplemental agreement to the sale and purchase agreement for the disposal of the land and retail complex.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM42.00 million 现金出售位于 Negeri Sembilan Seremban 的 40,680 平方米土地及附设单层零售综合楼。
actions.text_en: Disposed of a 40,680 square metre parcel of land with a single-storey retail complex in Seremban, Negeri Sembilan, for a total cash consideration of RM42.00 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM3,800,000.00 现金出售 Centro Heights Sdn. Bhd. 全部股权。
actions.text_en: Disposed of the entire equity interest in Centro Heights Sdn. Bhd. for a cash consideration of RM3,800,000.00.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM30.00 收购 NexV Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. 30% 股权，并终止与 GoAuto Group Sdn. Bhd. 的合资及股东协议。
actions.text_en: Acquired a 30% equity interest in NexV Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. for RM30.00 and terminated the joint venture and shareholders agreement with GoAuto Group Sdn. Bhd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 收购 NexV Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. 30% 股权并终止原有合资协议，持股方式由合资转为直接参股。
model_changes.text_en: Acquired a 30% equity interest in NexV Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. and terminated the existing joint venture agreement, shifting from a joint venture to a direct equity stake.
